title: THOS blinded sample-size re-estimation and nuisance-variance firewall
hypothesis: A synthetic protocol can distinguish a blinded nuisance-variance update from an outcome-informed adaptation by sealing treatment labels, prespecifying the information target, and rejecting any path that exposes arm-specific effects or silently changes the matched budget.
falsifier_or_gate: Mutate treatment-label visibility, variance source, timing, information target, sample-size cap, budget parity, adverse-event reservation, and result language; any unblinding or post-hoc change must fail.
evidence_class: bounded structural, proxy, open-gap, or exact-gate software evidence
boundary: Acceptance is confined to the frozen software evidence class and cannot promote empirical, participant, identity, authority, privacy, security, accessibility, deployment, or Stage 20 claims.
